3. It was further stated that the decree holders filed Execution Case No.01 of 2014 Subordinate Judge, 3rd   Court, Chittagong but same was not within the knowledge of the present applicant. It came to their knowledge when the petitioner collected the certified copy of the execution order on 25.03.2015 then the applicant came to Dhaka and tried to contact his engaged lawyer Mr. M.A. laud. He there came to learn that their learned Advocate retired from his profession on 06.01.2008 and subsequently died on 29.01.2012. 

 4. In the supplementary affidavit it has been slated that the learned filing lawyer Mr. M.A. Jalil did not perform his duty either to his client or to the section properly to inform about his inability to plead for the petitioner, such conduct of the learned Advocate for the petitioner applicant could not suffer. Thereafter another supplementary affidavit was filed on 30.04.2015. the revisional application was appeared in the blank daily cause list on 21.01.2009 although no one appears for both the parties, the learned Judge was pleased to discharge the rule and affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the court below. The learned advocate has expressed his sorrow and offered apology for his default in not appearing at the time of hearing of the rule and ready to pay cost.
